messages:
ana: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 5xxs from hosted inference in us-west2 starting ~08:04 UTC. Error pattern looks like control-plane dependency failures (routing/policy + config DB). I'm opening this thread to collect repros and owners. @tara_sre can you pull alerts?

sam: saw it too — graphs show spike in control-plane 5xx rate ~08:03 -> ~08:14, peak ~12% of requests. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

mike_support: ticket INC-4789 from AcmeRetail escalated — they got 502s during an active demo and were billed for attempted requests. Customer angry, asked for root cause and credit.

lee_eng: quick summary from tracing: control-plane tried to call routing-policy-service, got 500s, and our gateway surfaced 502/503 to user. Trace ids: trace=01a2b3.., example header x-rw-trace: 01a2b3:08:04:22.

tara_sre: alert list: control-plane-5xx-rate (P95) fired at 08:05. config-db latency alarm at 08:06 (pg_query_latency > 1s). Also a DB connection exhaustion alert from proxy at 08:07.

opsbot: deploy-bot noticed a canary deploy completed ~07:58 of `policy-client` 1.5.7 to routing-policy-service.

ana: @opsbot (typo, meant @opsbot) — can you post the deploy details?

deploy-bot: deploy: routing-policy-service v2.4.9 -> v2.5.0 (policy-client 1.5.7) finished at 07:58:41 UTC. Canary 10/10 passed quickly.

lee_eng: grabbing logs from policy-service: `kubectl -n control-plane logs deploy/routing-policy-service -c app --since=15m` shows repeated stack traces: `NullPointerException in PolicyClient.java: fetchPolicy -> fallback path missing` and many 500 responses to /policy/evaluate.

(quoted log snippet)
```
2026-03-15T08:04:12Z ERROR PolicyEvaluator - error evaluating route
java.lang.NullPointerException: attempt to invoke method on null
    at com.redwood.policy.PolicyClient.fetchPolicy(PolicyClient.java:214)
    at com.redwood.policy.PolicyEvaluator.evaluate(PolicyEvaluator.java:87)
    ...
```

sam: config-db (postgres) shows connection queue growing. pgbouncer metrics: `cl_active=200, cl_waiting=80, max_client_conn=280, pools=exhausted` and `pooler_waiting > 50`.

tara_sre: looks like two problems stacked: (1) policy-client regression causing NPEs and 5xx from routing-policy-service; (2) config-db slow queries (long txns) leading to pgbouncer queueing and timeouts. Together they propagated 5xxs to control-plane.

mike_support: customers also reported billing anomalies — tokens were consumed on failed requests. Support needs exact cutoff window for credits (INC-4789).

ana: timeline so far: 07:58 deploy -> 08:03 first 5xxs -> 08:05 alerts -> 08:10 paging SRE/Eng.

lee_eng: repro steps I've been using:
1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-3x","prompt":"hi"}'
2) observe HTTP/2 502 with body: `{"error":"control-plane: routing policy error"}`
headers include `x-rw-trace` and `x-rw-controlplane-error: routing-policy-500`.

(added) also captured control-plane logs for the request id:
```
INFO control-router - routing attempt -> policy-eval requestId=01a2b3
ERROR control-router - policy eval failed requestId=01a2b3 err=PolicyService(500)
ERROR control-router - returning 502 to client requestId=01a2b3
```

tara_sre: mitigation plan proposals: A) rollback routing-policy-service to v2.4.9 ; B) scale pgbouncer / increase max_db_connections and identify long-running txns; C) enable circuit-breaker fallback to default policy for a short window. Which can we do quickly?

lee_eng: rollback is fastest for policy-client regression. I can push rollback to canary then prod in ~7-10m if SRE approves. Circuit-breaker fallback is a code path change — requires quick patch and deploy, slower.

tara_sre: I'm going to add DB capacity first: increasing pgbouncer pool size by 50% in us-west2 and killing obvious long-running queries (>60s) after notifying services. Doing now.

opsbot: psql@config-db-primary: `SELECT pid, state, query, now() - query_start AS duration FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' ORDER BY duration DESC;` shows a few maintenance queries (vacuum full ?) and an analytic job from analytics-service taking 4m.

mike_support: please confirm the billing window for credits while you do fixes. We promised AcmeRetail an update in 30m.

ana: @mike_support create a billing hold? We should refund tokens for failed requests in interval 08:03-08:14. @finance FYI (cc internal finance).

lee_eng: rollback started: `kubectl set image deploy/routing-policy-service routing-policy-service=registry/redwood/routing-policy:v2.4.9` canary 2/2 now healthy (08:22). Observability shows policy-service error-rate dropping to baseline ~08:26.

tara_sre: pgbouncer pool increased and killed stale analytic job after notify (owner: analytics). pgbouncer cl_waiting dropped to <5 by 08:25. DB latency P95 back to baseline ~100ms.

deploy-bot: rollback completed across prod clusters at 08:28:12 UTC.

lee_eng: verified end-to-end: retried the earlier curl, got 200, generation returned token usage 34 tokens. Trace id shows control-plane path through policy-service succeeded.

mike_support: I notified AcmeRetail with partial root cause and that we will credit failed tokens within 24h. They're still asking for incident report.

tara_sre: initial root-cause summary for postmortem: regression in policy-client v1.5.7 caused NPEs under certain null-response conditions -> routing-policy-service returned 500s. Simultaneous config-db connection pressure (long analytic job + pgbouncer pool at preconfigured limit) amplified errors and delayed recovery. Combined effect: control-plane surfaced 502/503 to some hosted inference requests.

lee_eng: action items (owners):
- lee_eng: create PR to add defensive null-checks and unit tests in policy-client + add fallback path (ETA 1d).
- tara_sre: increase pgbouncer pool by default and add adaptive scaling (ETA 2d).
- ana: update rollout playbook to autoscale canary if dependent downstream errors spike (ETA 3d).
- mike_support: finalize customer credits and update INC-4789 (ETA 24h).

ana: also adding telemetry: when policy-service 5xx > 1% we should auto-enable a fallback routing policy for 5m. Filed ticket INF-992.

sam: quick note — we should also avoid billing customers for requests that returned client-visible 5xx. Mike, please coordinate with billing to flag these tokens for reversal.

mike_support: on it. Will prepare list of trace ids and time windows, and request automated refund job.

opsbot: incident timeline saved to #incidents-log at 09:05 UTC.

tara_sre: ok, closing thread for real-time coordination. We'll keep channel updated with postmortem link when drafted. Good work triaging. :thumbsup:

mike_support: thanks everyone — I'll post message to customer and cc once credits scheduled.

(THREAD CLOSED)
